name: Stockholm
vibe: Just the two of you, staying with Swedish family who celebrate Midsommar. You've done the tourist highlights. 4 nights, some evenings with family. Jun 19-20 is Midsommar — the city shuts down.

weather.conditions: Long daylight (18+ hrs), mostly sunny with occasional rain showers

specialNotes.title: Midsommar (Jun 19-20)
specialNotes.body: You arrive on Midsommar Eve — Sweden's biggest holiday. Your family will be celebrating. Everything else is closed. Join the family's Midsommar — maypole dancing, flower crowns, herring feast, snapsvisor (aquavit drinking songs). If you want a public celebration too: Skansen (Djurgården) holds Stockholm's biggest public Midsommar. Buy tickets in advance.

confirmedOpenMidsommar.type: Day trips — with Midsommar celebrations on islands

activities.name: Archipelago ferry to Grinda
activities.description: Best island for a summer day trip. 1.5-2 hrs by Cinderella boat (Stromma, departs Strandvagen) or Waxholmsbolaget (departs Stromkajen by the Grand Hotel). Nature reserve, quiet beaches, 3-hr walking trail around the island, Grinda Wardshus for lunch. Book ferry tickets in advance (~$22 each way). Islands have their own Midsommar celebrations Jun 19-20.

activities.name: Fotografiska
activities.description: World-class photography museum, Södermalm waterfront. Open until 11pm daily. CLOSED on Midsommar Eve (Jun 19). Top-floor bar has panoramic views. No museum admission required for the bar.

activities.name: Monteliusvägen at sunset
activities.description: Cliffside walking path in Södermalm. Best free panoramic view of the city. June light at 9-10pm is extraordinary.

activities.name: SoFo neighborhood
activities.description: South of Folkungagatan, Södermalm. Independent shops, vintage stores, small galleries. Stockholm's creative core. Best on weekdays; some shops close Midsommar weekend.

activities.name: Moderna Museet
activities.description: Modern art museum on Skeppsholmen island. Free permanent collection (Dali, Rauschenberg). Beautiful walk across the bridge.

activities.name: Rosendals Trädgård
activities.description: Biodynamic garden cafe on Djurgården. Pastries and salads from what's growing around you. Card only. Combine with a walk along Djurgårdsbrunnsviken canal.

activities.name: Spritmuseum
activities.description: Swedish spirits museum on Djurgården. History of aquavit, the Absolut Vodka art collection. Irreverent and fun. Check Midsommar hours.

activities.name: Östermalms Saluhall
activities.description: Grand 1888 food hall, recently renovated. Browse the counters, eat at Lisa Elmqvist (seafood counter since 1926).

restaurants.name: Hantverket
restaurants.vibe: Modern Swedish bistro + cocktail bar. Polished, food-forward, dinner-focused — chosen as the anniversary dinner over the wine-bistro alternative. Locked the matsalen (dining room) over the kitchen bar for a calmer room.
restaurants.confirmation: Mon Jun 22 · 19:45-22:00 · 2 pax · Dining room · ref #66708931 · card on file (325 SEK/guest no-show)

restaurants.name: Sturehof
restaurants.vibe: Grand seafood brasserie since 1897. Toast Skagen, daily fish, great wine. The place where Stockholm's food world goes for a "normal" dinner. Live-verified wide availability on Sun Jun 21.
restaurants.bookHow: sturehof.com (Waiteraid). Confirmed open every day including Midsommar and Sun Jun 21 (the classic reentry-dinner pick).

restaurants.name: Café Nizza
restaurants.vibe: French-Italian wine bar/bistro in Södermalm. Natural wine, neighborhood energy. The runner-up for the anniversary dinner — Mon Jun 22 19:45 was bookable when we picked Hantverket instead.
restaurants.bookHow: cafenizza.se — Waiteraid widget (hash 8157635663273fe0e81c48dff96542e8). Closed Midsommar weekend.

restaurants.name: Främmat
restaurants.vibe: Tiny Dalagatan bistro — intimate room, serious cooking. Mon Jun 22 had 17:30 and 20:15 bookable for 2; 19:00 was full/waitlist.

restaurants.name: Oaxen Slip
restaurants.vibe: Bib Gourmand casual bistro in a converted boatyard on Djurgården. Modern Nordic, seasonal, waterfront. Walk-in only since rebrand.
restaurants.bookHow: Walk-in only (rebranded as "Slipen", +46 8 551 531 05 to verify wait)

restaurants.name: Pelikan
restaurants.vibe: Historic beer hall since 1904. Traditional Swedish home cooking in a stunning Art Nouveau interior. Meatballs, herring, Jansson's temptation. Closed Sun + Mon — only useful Tue Jun 23 daytime.
restaurants.bookHow: Recommended. Closed Jun 19-20 (Midsommar) and closed all Sun/Mon.

restaurants.name: Meatballs for the People
restaurants.vibe: Every variety of Swedish meatball — elk, wild boar, classic. Casual, no booking needed.

restaurants.name: Lisa Elmqvist
restaurants.vibe: Seafood counter inside Östermalms Saluhall. Since 1926. Sit at the counter, eat whatever's fresh.

restaurants.name: Rosendals Trädgård
restaurants.vibe: Biodynamic garden cafe on Djurgården. Wood-fired bread and pastries from what's growing around you. Lunch served 11am-3:30pm. Card only. Closed Jun 19-21 for Midsommar — use Mon Jun 22 daytime.

bars.name: Tjoget
bars.vibe: Hornstull, Södermalm. On the World's Best Bars extended list (Top 100). Five spaces including a wine bodega and beer cafe. Mediterranean/North African flavor profiles. Open until 3am weekends. The real deal.

bars.name: Pharmarium
bars.vibe: Gamla Stan, Stortorget 7. Inside Sweden's first public pharmacy (1575). Apothecary aesthetic, genuinely inventive cocktails. Intimate, moody. Book ahead.

bars.name: Lucy's Flower Shop
bars.vibe: Östermalm (Birger Jarlsgatan). Tiny creative cocktail bar with an on-site lab. Limited seating — reserve.

bars.name: Cachette
bars.vibe: Norrmalm. Hidden wine + cocktails spot. France/Italy/Lebanon list. The kind of place you find and tell nobody about.

bars.name: Fooli
bars.vibe: Eastern Södermalm. Wine bar run by two award-winning sommeliers. Won Best Bar and Drinking Experience of the Year. Strong French focus, serious cellar.

bars.name: Fotografiska bar
bars.vibe: Top-floor bar at the museum. Harbor views, good wine list. Open until 11pm. No museum admission required. Likely open Midsommar.

coffee.name: Drop Coffee
coffee.vibe: Stockholm's most decorated specialty roaster. Light roasts, SoFo. The standard.

coffee.name: Café Pascal
coffee.vibe: Multiple locations. Won Stockholm's best cafe (Gulddraken). Own roasts, own pastries. The kouign-amann and cardamom buns are exceptional. Your fika spot. Great for a breakfast-out morning — kouign-amann + coffee is a meal.

coffee.name: Vete-Katten
coffee.vibe: City center, since 1928. Traditional Swedish konditori — princess cake, cinnamon rolls. Old Stockholm in the best way. Open early — a proper Swedish breakfast of cardamom buns, open-face sandwiches, and strong coffee.

bookingPriorities.how: sturehof.com → BOKA BORD (Waiteraid). Wide availability live-verified.
bookingPriorities.why: Classic reentry dinner after the Midsommar weekend — the city institution.
Pick one planned cocktail night before/after a dinner. Tjoget + Folii stay flexible walk-ins.

bookingPriorities.restaurant: Sauna float — Hellasgården or B7 Bath
bookingPriorities.how: Hellasgården: drop-in. B7 Bath: book slot via their site.
bookingPriorities.why: Sun Jun 21 late afternoon + Sturehof dinner is the Swedish-summer-Sunday move.
